Slash command.d: In Claude Code, an instruction that starts with / at the beginning of a message, such as /clear or /model. Some are built into the program; others are skills or come from plugins and MCP servers.

Bundled skill.d: A skill that ships with Claude Code, such as /code-review or /simplify. It gives Claude detailed instructions that it carries out with its normal tools.

Checkpoint.d: A snapshot of Claude's file edits saved at the start of each turn in Claude Code, so you can go back to it with /rewind. Not a replacement for git.

Compaction.d: Replacing a long conversation with a shorter summary to free space in the context window, either automatically or with /compact.

Alias.d: Another name for the same command. For example /reset and /new are aliases of /clear.
